text: We can’t confirm if this asset lost tree cover since 2020. The analysis couldn’t be completed because the required satellite data wasn’t available for this area. Key datasets like Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, and MGAP 2021 weren’t prepared for this asset, leaving no observations to assess. Without this coverage, we can’t rule out tree-cover loss or confirm it didn’t happen. The evidence is insufficient to make any conclusion.
